proportion_guides.note: The golden divisions of a 32-unit cell are approximately 12.22 and 19.78. Snap to the integer grid when useful; do not distort a semantic distinction to meet a ratio. Two-unit clear gaps and axial strokes are design-review targets, not universal constraints on curved or joined glyphs.

semantic_constraints: A glyph is a learned name, not a proof or an instance of its referent.
Reuse may suggest a family but does not establish ontological inclusion or entailment.
Do not distinguish semantically opposed terms solely by scale, rotation, or a tiny dot.
Test related marks at actual text sizes; unequal outlines alone do not establish perceptual distinctness.

semantic_exceptions.rationale: The plain ring and ring with central dot are a conventional unmarked/marked pair naming the exhaustive distinction in A3. The shared ring is typographic structure, not a Boundary or empty region. Both inscriptions are Presence under A4; adding or removing the dot does not depict creation, destruction or a transformation between their referents.
semantic_exceptions.conditions: Retain the existing Presence dot and shared ring geometry, stable font slots and accessible labels. Check the pair at actual tile, graph and mathematical text sizes; shape uniqueness alone does not establish reader discrimination. This exception does not license other dot-only oppositions.
